universities.name: University of Malaya
universities.description: Malaysia's oldest university and consistently its highest-ranked, with roots going back to 1905 (founded in Singapore as the King Edward VII College of Medicine; renamed University of Malaya in 1949 and recognised as a public university in Malaya from 1962). Based in Kuala Lumpur, UM offers a wide range of programmes across multiple faculties. Its International Channel accepts the Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) for most undergraduate programmes, and recognised bachelor's degrees for postgraduate study.

admissionRequirements.undergraduate: Completion of 12 years of schooling with a Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC), accepted for most programmes through UM's International Channel. Minimum marks and subjects are set per programme (for example, Engineering: 65% average with at least 60% in Mathematics and Physics; Business Administration: about 70% average). Qualifications graded on a different scale are assessed by UM through a cross-matching process. Medicine does not list the HSC as a direct entry route (accepted routes include A-Level, IB and Foundation/Matriculation). Meeting the requirements makes you eligible to apply; it does not guarantee admission.
admissionRequirements.postgraduate: Recognised Bachelor's degree with a minimum CGPA of 3.00 (or equivalent). Some programmes consider a CGPA of 2.50–2.99 if extra criteria are met (for example an interview, relevant work experience or publications). Degrees from foreign institutions must be recognised in the Malaysian Qualifications Register. Requirements vary by programme and admission is not guaranteed.

tuitionFees.undergraduate: RM 60,900 – RM 149,200 total programme fee for most programmes (international, 2025/26); Pharmacy RM 280,100, Dentistry RM 655,000, Medicine RM 673,200. UM quotes fees for the whole programme, not per year.
tuitionFees.postgraduate: Master's coursework mostly RM 25,000 – RM 80,000 total; PhD roughly RM 50,000 – RM 100,000 total (international, 2025/26). UM quotes fees for the whole programme, not per year.

universities.scholarships: UM Scholarship Scheme (UMSS) and Graduate Research Assistantship Scheme (GRAS/iGRAS) for Master's and PhD research students (postgraduate only); PTE x Universiti Malaya Scholarship (£3,000 towards tuition for international students). The Malaysia International Scholarship (MIS) is a Malaysian government postgraduate scheme for selected countries, not a UM scholarship; check whether Bangladesh is eligible.

courses.entryRequirements: UM does not list the HSC as a direct entry route for international applicants. Accepted routes include A-Level (grade A in Biology and Chemistry, and A in Physics or Mathematics), IB (36 points) or Foundation/Matriculation (CGPA 3.80/4.00). An admission test score (MSAT/BMAT/MCAT/GAMSAT) and an interview are required.

universities.name: Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia
universities.description: Malaysia's national university, founded on 18 May 1970 (it began in Kuala Lumpur and moved to its main campus in Bangi, Selangor, in 1977). A leading public research university offering programmes across sciences, engineering, medicine, law, and social sciences. Its UKM International (UKMi) route accepts the Bangladeshi Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) for undergraduate study, and recognised bachelor's degrees for postgraduate study.

admissionRequirements.undergraduate: Completion of 12 years of schooling with a Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC), applied through UKM International (UKMi). UKM sets a minimum HSC percentage by country: for Bangladesh it is 80% for most programmes (Engineering, IT, Science, Law, Education, Business) and 85% for Medicine and Dentistry. Required subjects vary by faculty (for example Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry/Biology for Engineering and IT; Biology, Chemistry and Mathematics/Physics for Medicine). An interview may be required. UKM does not state a GPA equivalent on its pages, so check how your HSC result converts. Meeting the requirements makes you eligible to apply; it does not guarantee admission.
admissionRequirements.postgraduate: Recognised Bachelor's degree with a good CGPA from an institution recognised by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency (MQA) or accredited by a recognised foreign body; further requirements are set by each faculty or institute. Admission is not guaranteed.

englishRequirements.toefl: 35 - 93 iBT (varies by faculty; HEET also accepted)

tuitionFees.undergraduate: RM 59,920 – RM 90,820 total programme fee for most programmes (UKMi international fee schedule 2024/25); Medicine RM 552,520 total. UKM quotes fees for the whole programme, and a 6% Sales and Service Tax is added for international students.
tuitionFees.postgraduate: Master's roughly RM 28,000 – RM 40,000 total (for example Master of Laws RM 31,910); PhD about RM 71,820 total (Faculty of Law, minimum 8 semesters). Fees vary by faculty and mode of study.

universities.scholarships: Malaysia International Scholarship (MIS) and Malaysian Technical Cooperation Programme (MTCP) are Malaysian government postgraduate schemes that UKM supports (eligibility depends on your country); UKM Graduate Research Assistantship (GRA) and the UKM Zamalah Scheme support Master's and PhD research students, including international students; Dermasiswa financial aid is for students from low and lower-middle-income countries.

universities.name: University of Barcelona
universities.description: Catalonia's largest public university, founded in 1450 and based in Barcelona. Most degrees are taught in Spanish or Catalan; a limited set of bachelor's and master's programmes (for example International Business and several master's in Economics, Business and Life Sciences) are taught in English.

admissionRequirements.undergraduate: Bangladeshi HSC (12 years of schooling) is not in a Spain agreement system, so the usual route is homologation of the HSC to the Spanish Título de Bachiller through the Spanish Ministry of Education (the Ministry publishes an equivalence sheet for Bangladesh); the homologated mark is then used as the access grade in the Catalan university pre-enrolment (the UNEDasiss PCE exams are optional, to raise the grade). Subject prerequisites apply per degree. Bangladesh GPA-to-Spanish grade conversion is not stated here and must be confirmed. UB follows the Catalan pre-enrolment system; confirm the current non-EU procedure with UB. Spanish- or Catalan-taught degrees also require proof of Spanish/Catalan.
admissionRequirements.postgraduate: Recognised 4-year Bachelor's (Honours) degree in a relevant field; non-EU degrees do not need prior homologation to apply, but the diploma and transcripts must be legalised (Apostille or diplomatic route) for enrolment. Each master's sets its own minimum grade and documents (not confirmed here).

englishRequirements.ielts: Only for English-taught programmes; level set per programme (B2 is typical, about IELTS 5.5 – 6.5). Not required for Spanish/Catalan-taught degrees.
englishRequirements.toefl: B2 equivalent (about 72 – 94 iBT) where a certificate is requested

tuitionFees.undergraduate: Approx. EUR 1,100 – 1,250 per year (estimate: Catalan public price of EUR 17.69 per credit, about EUR 1,061 for 60 ECTS plus fees; the non-resident non-EU bachelor rate could not be confirmed on UB's official pages)
tuitionFees.postgraduate: Approx. EUR 4,900 – 6,600 per year for non-EU students in official master's (about EUR 82 per credit; International Business about EUR 110 per credit; 2025/26 figures)

universities.name: Pompeu Fabra University
universities.description: A public university in Barcelona founded in 1990, strong in economics, social sciences, law, communication and ICT. Offers seven bachelor's degrees in English (including Global Studies and International Business Economics) and several English-taught master's programmes. Non-EU students pay much higher fees than EU students.

admissionRequirements.undergraduate: Bangladeshi HSC (12 years of schooling) is not in a Spain agreement system, so the usual route is homologation of the HSC to the Spanish Título de Bachiller through the Spanish Ministry of Education (the Ministry publishes an equivalence sheet for Bangladesh); the homologated mark is then used as the access grade in the Catalan university pre-enrolment (the UNEDasiss PCE exams are optional, to raise the grade). Subject prerequisites apply per degree. Bangladesh GPA-to-Spanish grade conversion is not stated here and must be confirmed. UPF applies the Catalan system; confirm the current non-EU procedure and deadlines with UPF.
admissionRequirements.postgraduate: Recognised 4-year Bachelor's (Honours) degree in a relevant field. UPF states that a non-EU degree not yet homologated carries an extra enrolment fee (EUR 218.15 in 2025/26). Each master's sets its own admission criteria (not confirmed here).

englishRequirements.ielts: English-taught programmes: B2 recommended or required (about IELTS 5.5 – 6.5); master's such as Intelligent Interactive Systems list about IELTS 5.5 (third-party figure). Not required for Spanish/Catalan-taught degrees.
englishRequirements.toefl: B2 equivalent (about 72 – 94 iBT); one master's listing shows about 72

tuitionFees.undergraduate: Approx. EUR 6,800 – 7,000 per year for non-EU students (2025/26: EUR 6,800.32 for most degrees; Audiovisual Communication EUR 7,022.30; double degrees from about EUR 11,500). Includes administrative charges and insurance.
tuitionFees.postgraduate: EUR 5,749.80 per 60 ECTS for non-EU students in most official master's (EUR 93.50 per credit, 2025/26 figures)

universities.scholarships: Erasmus Mundus joint master's programmes (such as the Master in Artificial Intelligence) are linked to UPF and may include scholarships; UPF's own scholarships for non-EU students were not confirmed

universities.name: Universitat Internacional de Catalunya
universities.description: A private non-profit university in Barcelona founded in 1997, with campuses in Barcelona and Sant Cugat del Vallès. Offers 16 bachelor's degrees, with English-taught options such as Business Administration and Bioengineering and part-English programmes in Dentistry and Architecture.

admissionRequirements.undergraduate: UIC states that students from outside the EU must have their upper-secondary qualification officially recognised: homologation through the Spanish Ministry of Education, with enrolment possible using the conditional registration receipt issued when the homologation starts. UNEDasiss applies to EU/IB systems, not to non-European systems like Bangladeshi HSC. UIC also runs its own admission process (application, and for some degrees a test and personal interview). Bangladesh GPA conversion is not stated here.
admissionRequirements.postgraduate: Recognised Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; each master's has its own admission process and documents (not confirmed here).

englishRequirements.ielts: For English-taught degrees an English level of B1 – B2 is asked (about IELTS 5.5 – 6.5). For Business Administration in English, B2 must be certified to graduate but is not needed to start.
englishRequirements.toefl: B2 equivalent (about 72 – 94 iBT) accepted where a certificate is requested

tuitionFees.undergraduate: Approx. EUR 4,500 – 15,000 per year depending on the degree (UIC's own published range; the same fees apply to EU and non-EU students)
tuitionFees.postgraduate: Approx. EUR 2,000 – 15,000 per year depending on the programme (UIC's own published range)

universities.scholarships: UIC offers an International Excellence Scholarship (BEI) for international students in the Business Administration English programme; other scholarships exist, details to be confirmed
